      1  # Idris 2 Development                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2                                                                                                                                                                                                        
      3  Use this skill when the user asks for Idris, dependent types, type-driven development, or proofs in Idris 2.                                                                                          
      4                                                                                                                                                                                                        
      5  ## Environment                                                                                                                                                                                        
      6                                                                                                                                                                                                        
      7  - Idris 2 is installed at `/opt/homebrew/bin/idris2` (version 0.8.0).                                                                                                                                 
      8  - Package manager: `idris2 --list-packages` shows available libs (`base`, `contrib`, `network`, etc.).                                                                                                
      9  - No built-in JSON library; use simple string parsing or external libs if needed.                                                                                                                     
     10                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     11  ## Common Commands                                                                                                                                                                                    
     12                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     13  ```bash                                                                                                                                                                                               
     14  idris2 --version                                                                                                                                                                                      
     15  idris2 --check MyFile.idr        # type-check only                                                                                                                                                    
     16  idris2 MyFile.idr                # compile and run Main.main                                                                                                                                          
     17  idris2 --exec 'printLn (the Int (1 + 2))'  # one-shot eval                                                                                                                                            
     18  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                   
     19                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     20  ## File/module conventions                                                                                                                                                                            
     21                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     22  - File `Main.idr` can omit `module` or use `module Main`.                                                                                                                                             
     23  - File `Foo.idr` should start with `module Foo`.                                                                                                                                                      
     24  - Keep module name and file name in sync.                                                                                                                                                             
     25                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     26  ## Idioms                                                                                                                                                                                             
     27                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     28  - Use `the Type value` to disambiguate types (e.g. `the Int 42`).                                                                                                                                     
     29  - Use `pure`/`>>=` for `IO`.                                                                                                                                                                          
     30  - `Bool`, `Nat`, `List`, `Vect`, `Maybe`, `Either` are in `Prelude`.                                                                                                                                  
     31  - Define total functions with `covering` or `total` when possible.                                                                                                                                    
     32  - Use holes (`?myhole`) and `:t myhole` in the REPL to let the type guide implementation.                                                                                                             
     33                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     34  ## MCP tools available                                                                                                                                                                                
     35                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     36  The local MCP server `idris` provides:                                                                                                                                                                
     37  - `typecheck_idris` — pass Idris source as `code`.                                                                                                                                                    
     38  - `eval_idris` — pass an expression with a `Show` instance as `expression`.                                                                                                                           
     39  - `get_idris_version` — return Idris version.                                                                                                                                                         
     40                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     41  Prefer calling these tools instead of guessing type-checker output.                                                                                                                                   
     42                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     43  ## When stuck                                                                                                                                                                                         
     44                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     45  1. Type-check early and often.                                                                                                                                                                        
     46  2. Replace the right-hand side with a hole (`?rhs`) and inspect the goal.                                                                                                                             
     47  3. Use `case` splits and the type to drive the implementation.                                                                                                                                        
     48  4. Check totality with `:total <name>` in the REPL.

      1  # Learn Idris 2                                                                                                                                                                                       
      2                                                                                                                                                                                                        
      3  Use this skill when the user wants to learn Idris 2, dependent types, type-driven development, or asks for Idris exercises, explanations, or a curriculum.                                            
      4                                                                                                                                                                                                        
      5  ## Role                                                                                                                                                                                               
      6                                                                                                                                                                                                        
      7  You are a patient Idris 2 tutor. Explain concepts through short, runnable examples. Prefer letting the type checker drive discovery. Use the local `idris` MCP server (`typecheck_idris`,             
   `eval_idris`) to verify code in real time.                                                                                                                                                                  
      8                                                                                                                                                                                                        
      9  ## Environment                                                                                                                                                                                        
     10                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     11  - Idris 2 is installed at `/opt/homebrew/bin/idris2` (version 0.8.0).                                                                                                                                 
     12  - Local MCP server `idris` is available with tools:                                                                                                                                                   
     13    - `typecheck_idris` — type-check Idris source.                                                                                                                                                      
     14    - `eval_idris` — evaluate an expression (must have a `Show` instance; numeric literals need explicit type, e.g. `the Int (1 + 2)`).                                                                 
     15    - `get_idris_version` — show Idris version.                                                                                                                                                         
     16                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     17  ## Curriculum                                                                                                                                                                                         
     18                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     19  ### 1. First contact                                                                                                                                                                                  
     20                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     21  Start in the REPL:                                                                                                                                                                                    
     22                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     23  ```bash                                                                                                                                                                                               
     24  idris2                                                                                                                                                                                                
     25  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                   
     26                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     27  Try:                                                                                                                                                                                                  
     28                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     29  ```idris                                                                                                                                                                                              
     30  1 + 2                                                                                                                                                                                                 
     31  :q                                                                                                                                                                                                    
     32  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                   
     33                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     34  Note: numeric literals are polymorphic, so you may need `the Int (1 + 2)`.                                                                                                                            
     35                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     36  ### 2. Functions and types                                                                                                                                                                            
     37                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     38  Create `Hello.idr`:                                                                                                                                                                                   
     39                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     40  ```idris                                                                                                                                                                                              
     41  module Hello                                                                                                                                                                                          
     42                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     43  export                                                                                                                                                                                                
     44  greet : String -> String                                                                                                                                                                              
     45  greet name = "Hello, " ++ name                                                                                                                                                                        
     46                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     47  export                                                                                                                                                                                                
     48  main : IO ()                                                                                                                                                                                          
     49  main = putStrLn (greet "Idris")                                                                                                                                                                       
     50  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                   
     51                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     52  Run:                                                                                                                                                                                                  
     53                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     54  ```bash                                                                                                                                                                                               
     55  idris2 Hello.idr                                                                                                                                                                                      
     56  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                   
     57                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     58  ### 3. Pattern matching and recursion                                                                                                                                                                 
     59                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     60  ```idris                                                                                                                                                                                              
     61  module NatPlay                                                                                                                                                                                        
     62                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     63  public export                                                                                                                                                                                         
     64  double : Nat -> Nat                                                                                                                                                                                   
     65  double Z     = Z                                                                                                                                                                                      
     66  double (S k) = S (S (double k))                                                                                                                                                                       
     67                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     68  -- Type-check only:                                                                                                                                                                                   
     69  -- idris2 --check NatPlay.idr                                                                                                                                                                         
     70  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                   
     71                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     72  ### 4. Dependent types: `Vect`                                                                                                                                                                        
     73                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     74  ```idris                                                                                                                                                                                              
     75  module VectPlay                                                                                                                                                                                       
     76                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     77  import Data.Vect                                                                                                                                                                                      
     78                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     79  public export                                                                                                                                                                                         
     80  append : Vect n a -> Vect m a -> Vect (n + m) a                                                                                                                                                       
     81  append []        ys = ys                                                                                                                                                                              
     82  append (x :: xs) ys = x :: append xs ys                                                                                                                                                               
     83  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                   
     84                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     85  Key insight: the length is in the type, so `append` cannot drop elements.                                                                                                                             
     86                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     87  ### 5. `Fin` for bounded indices                                                                                                                                                                      
     88                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     89  ```idris                                                                                                                                                                                              
     90  module FinPlay                                                                                                                                                                                        
     91                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     92  import Data.Vect                                                                                                                                                                                      
     93                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     94  public export                                                                                                                                                                                         
     95  safeIndex : Fin n -> Vect n a -> a                                                                                                                                                                    
     96  safeIndex FZ     (x :: _ )  = x                                                                                                                                                                       
     97  safeIndex (FS k) (_ :: xs) = safeIndex k xs                                                                                                                                                           
     98  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                   
     99                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    100  `Fin n` represents numbers `0 .. n-1`, so out-of-bounds access is a type error.                                                                                                                       
    101                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    102  ### 6. Type-driven development with holes                                                                                                                                                             
    103                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    104  Write a function with a hole and let the type guide you:                                                                                                                                              
    105                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    106  ```idris                                                                                                                                                                                              
    107  module Holes                                                                                                                                                                                          
    108                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    109  import Data.Vect                                                                                                                                                                                      
    110                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    111  public export                                                                                                                                                                                         
    112  replicateVect : (n : Nat) -> a -> Vect n a                                                                                                                                                            
    113  replicateVect Z     x = []                                                                                                                                                                            
    114  replicateVect (S k) x = x :: replicateVect k x                                                                                                                                                        
    115  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                   
    116                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    117  If you start with `replicateVect n x = ?rhs`, the REPL tells you the expected type.                                                                                                                   
    118                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    119  ### 7. Equality and proofs                                                                                                                                                                            
    120                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    121  ```idris                                                                                                                                                                                              
    122  module Proofs                                                                                                                                                                                         
    123                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    124  public export                                                                                                                                                                                         
    125  plusZeroRightNeutral : (n : Nat) -> n + 0 = n                                                                                                                                                         
    126  plusZeroRightNeutral Z     = Refl                                                                                                                                                                     
    127  plusZeroRightNeutral (S k) = cong S (plusZeroRightNeutral k)                                                                                                                                          
    128  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                   
    129                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    130  `Refl` is the proof that `x = x`. `cong` says equal inputs give equal outputs.                                                                                                                        
    131                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    132  ### 8. Records and interfaces                                                                                                                                                                         
    133                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    134  ```idris                                                                                                                                                                                              
    135  module Records                                                                                                                                                                                        
    136                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    137  public export                                                                                                                                                                                         
    138  record Person where                                                                                                                                                                                   
    139    constructor MkPerson                                                                                                                                                                                
    140    name : String                                                                                                                                                                                       
    141    age  : Nat                                                                                                                                                                                          
    142                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    143  public export                                                                                                                                                                                         
    144  InterfaceExample : Person                                                                                                                                                                             
    145  InterfaceExample = MkPerson "Idris" 10                                                                                                                                                                
    146  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                   
    147                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    148  Interfaces (type classes):                                                                                                                                                                            
    149                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    150  ```idris                                                                                                                                                                                              
    151  public export                                                                                                                                                                                         
    152  interface Describable a where                                                                                                                                                                         
    153    describe : a -> String                                                                                                                                                                              
    154  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                   
    155                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    156  ## Common pitfalls                                                                                                                                                                                    
    157                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    158  - File/module name mismatch: `module Foo` in `Foo.idr`.                                                                                                                                               
    159  - Numeric ambiguity: use `the Int 42` or `the Nat 0`.                                                                                                                                                 
    160  - `IO` values must be bound with `<-` inside `do` notation.                                                                                                                                           
    161  - Totality: Idris warns about non-total functions by default; add `total` or `covering` when appropriate.                                                                                             
    162                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    163  ## Exercise progression                                                                                                                                                                               
    164                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    165  1. Write `factorial : Nat -> Nat`.                                                                                                                                                                    
    166  2. Write `reverseVect : Vect n a -> Vect n a`.                                                                                                                                                        
    167  3. Implement `map`, `filter` for `Vect` preserving length where possible.                                                                                                                             
    168  4. Prove `plusSuccRightSucc : (n : Nat) -> (m : Nat) -> n + S m = S (n + m)`.                                                                                                                         
    169  5. Define a type-safe `Expr` language with evaluation and a verified optimizer.                                                                                                                       
    170                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    171  ## Resources                                                                                                                                                                                          
    172                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    173  - Official docs: https://idris2.readthedocs.io/                                                                                                                                                       
    174  - Book: *Type-Driven Development with Idris* by Edwin Brady                                                                                                                                           
    175  - Idris 2 repo: https://github.com/idris-lang/Idris2                                                                                                                                                  
    176                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    177  ## Teaching style                                                                                                                                                                                     
    178                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    179  - Keep examples small and type-checkable.                                                                                                                                                             
    180  - When the user is stuck, suggest adding a hole (`?holeName`) and inspecting the goal.                                                                                                                
    181  - Prefer `Nat`, `Vect`, `Fin`, and `Maybe` for teaching before moving to custom indexed types.                                                                                                        
    182  - Validate snippets with the `idris` MCP server whenever possible.

     ● Resources                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
     ●File-like data that can be read by clients(like API responses or file contents)                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
     ● Prompts

     ●Text resources contain UTF-8 encoded text data. These are suitable for source code, configuration files, log files, JSON/XML data

     37  babyAIScore : String -> Nat                                                                                                                                                                           
     38  babyAIScore text = countHits text babyAIKeywords                                                                                                                                                      
     39    where                                                                                                                                                                                               
     40      lower : String -> String                                                                                                                                                                          
     41      lower s = pack (map toLower (unpack s))                                                                                                                                                           
     42                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     43      isInfix : String -> String -> Bool                                                                                                                                                                
     44      isInfix needle haystack =                                                                                                                                                                         
     45        let nlen = length needle                                                                                                                                                                        
     46            hlen = length haystack                                                                                                                                                                      
     47        in if nlen == 0                                                                                                                                                                                 
     48              then True                                                                                                                                                                                 
     49              else go 0                                                                                                                                                                                 
     50        where                                                                                                                                                                                           
     51          go : Nat -> Bool                                                                                                                                                                              
     52          go i = if i + length needle > length haystack                                                                                                                                                 
     53                    then False                                                                                                                                                                          
     54                    else if take (length needle) (drop i haystack) == needle                                                                                                                            
     55                            then True                                                                                                                                                                   
     56                            else go (S i)                                                                                                                                                               
     57                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     58      countHits : String -> List String -> Nat                                                                                                                                                          
     59      countHits _ [] = 0                                                                                                                                                                                
     60      countHits t (k :: ks) =                                                                                                                                                                           
     61        if isInfix (lower k) (lower t)                                                                                                                                                                  
     62           then S (countHits t ks)                                                                                                                                                                      
     63           else countHits t ks

     13  processOne dir fname = do                                                                                                                                                                             
     14    book <- inspectBook dir fname                                                                                                                                                                       
     15    let hits = countKeywordHits (textHead book) frameworkKeywords

     37  ||| A score: how many baby-AI keywords appear in the text.                                                                                                                                            
     38  public export                                                                                                                                                                                         
     39  babyAIScore : String -> Nat                                                                                                                                                                           
     40  babyAIScore text = countHits text babyAIKeywords                                                                                                                                                      
     41    where                                                                                                                                                                                               
     42      lower : String -> String                                                                                                                                                                          
     43      lower s = pack (map toLower (unpack s))                                                                                                                                                           
     44                                                                                                                                                                                                        
     45      countHits : String -> List String -> Nat                                                                                                                                                          
     46      countHits _ [] = 0                                                                                                                                                                                
     47      countHits t (k :: ks) =                                                                                                                                                                           
     48        if Data.String.isInfixOf (lower k) (lower t)                                                                                                                                                    
     49           then S (countHits t ks)                                                                                                                                                                      
     50           else countHits t ks

   A brief discussion on the similarities and differences                                                                                                                                                      
   between Chinese and Hungarian intonations                                                                                                                                                                   
   from the perspective of Chinese teaching                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   Abstract                                                                                                                                                                                                    
   As for what intonation means, linguists Crystal and Trask have each given                                                                                                                                   
   their own definitions, which are the two main views widely recognised by                                                                                                                                    
   the academic world today. The former is a narrow definition, whereas the                                                                                                                                    
   latter is broad. Among learners of Chinese as a second language, the students                                                                                                                               
   who are considered to have truly mastered the intonation of Chinese should                                                                                                                                  
   be those whom native speakers cannot identify as foreigners just by hearing                                                                                                                                 
   their’ voices. Therefore, the type of intonation discussed here is intonation in                                                                                                                            
   a broad sense.                                                                                                                                                                                              
   Chinese and Hungarian are linguistically distant far apart and belong to                                                                                                                                    
   different language families. Chinese is a tonal language. Zhao Yuanren (1922)                                                                                                                               
   believed that Chinese intonation includes sentence tone (intonation) and character tone (tonal morpheme). Chinese intonation is the result of sentence intonation being affected by a character’s tone.     
   However, how does character tone                                                                                                                                                                            
   affect sentence tone? This is obviously a complex process. Many Chinese                                                                                                                                     
   linguists have done a lot of research trying to reveal this process and the                                                                                                                                 
   relationship between sentence tone and character tone. In recent years, some                                                                                                                                
   scholars have achieved outstanding results with the help of experimental phonetics methods. We are glad to see that views on the characteristics of Chinese                                                 
   intonation have reached a consensus: the changes in Chinese intonation are                                                                                                                                  
   changes of scale, not simply the changing of pitch, and tones are basically unchanged. The core elements of Chinese tones are the focus accent and boundary tone.                                           
   Hungarian is a non-tonal language, where focus and stress play a key                                                                                                                                        
   role. A distinctive feature of Hungarian is that word stress is always placed                                                                                                                               
   on the first syllable. Focus position in Hungarian is mandatory and is always                                                                                                                               
   before the verb. In this article, we briefly discuss the similarities and differ-                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   jiangshanshan2011@gmail.com

   https://orcid.org/0009-0008-2808-1152                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   
   44

   ences between Chinese and Hungarian intonations from the perspective of                                                                                                                                     
   Chinese teaching, with a view to contribute to the teaching of Chinese as a second language.

   姜珊珊                                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   从汉语教学的角度浅谈汉匈语调的异同                                                                                                                                                                          
   摘要                                                                                                                                                                                                        
   对于什么是语调，语言学家Crystal和Trask都各自给出过定义，也是当                                                                                                                                              
   今学术界广泛认可的两种主要观点。前者是狭义的语调定义，后者是                                                                                                                                                
   广义的语调定义。在国际汉语教学中，真正掌握了汉语语调的学生，                                                                                                                                                
   应该是未见其面，只闻其声的情况下，作为母语者的我们听不出来他                                                                                                                                                
   是一个外国人。因此，我们这里讨论的语调，是广义的语调。                                                                                                                                                      
   汉语和匈牙利语相去甚远，分属不同的语系。汉语是声调语言。赵                                                                                                                                                  
   元任（1922）认为汉语语调包括句调和字调。汉语语调是句调受字调                                                                                                                                                
   影响的结果。但是字调如何影响句调呢？显然这是一个复杂的过程。                                                                                                                                                
   许多中国语言学家做了大量的研究，试图揭示这个过程以及句调和字                                                                                                                                                
   调的关系。近年来，一些学者借助实验语音学方法取得了可喜的成果。                                                                                                                                              
   匈牙利语是非声调语言，焦点和重音起着关键的作用。匈牙利语的                                                                                                                                                  
   一个显著特征是词重音总是在第一个音节。匈牙利语的焦点位置是强                                                                                                                                                
   制的，总是位于动词前。                                                                                                                                                                                      
   本文从汉语教学的角度，浅议汉匈语调的异同，以期有助于国际汉                                                                                                                                                  
   语教学。                                                                                                                                                                                                    
   关键词：语调，汉语语调，音阶，边界调，匈牙利语语调，重音，焦点                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   
   SHANSHAN JIANG: A brief discussion on the similarities and differences                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   45                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   Introduction                                                                                                                                                                                                
   In 2004, the first Confucius Institute in the world was established in Seoul,                                                                                                                               
   South Korea, for teaching Chinese language and strengthening cultural exchanges between China and other countries. In the following 20 years, international Chinese language education has flourished. To   
   date, more than                                                                                                                                                                                             
   500 Confucius Institutes and more than 1,000 Confucius Classrooms have                                                                                                                                      
   been established around the world. According to data released by the National                                                                                                                               
   Language and Characters Policy Research Center (国家语言文字政策研究                                                                                                                                        
   中心) in August 2023, 81 countries have included Chinese in their national                                                                                                                                  
   education systems.1 Faced with Chinese language learners from many language backgrounds, Chinese scholars have long begun language comparison                                                               
   and error analysis research, aiming to analyse the similarities and differences                                                                                                                             
   between Chinese and other languages, observe the common errors made by                                                                                                                                      
   students while learning, summarise the rules, let ‘positive transfer’ play a positive role, and prevent the negative effects of ‘negative transfer’. Regarding                                              
   these comparative studies, those related to intonation are few. Intonation                                                                                                                                  
   teaching has always been a weak link in Chinese language teaching. ‘For a                                                                                                                                   
   long time, there have been few research results on Chinese intonation, and                                                                                                                                  
   it is difficult to rely on them for textbook compilation or teaching’.2 Fortunately, in recent decades, ‘Chinese intonation research has made great progress and breakthroughs, and many clear and          
   empirical laws have been                                                                                                                                                                                    
   revealed. The core issues of Chinese intonation have basically been answered                                                                                                                                
   or solved’.3                                                                                                                                                                                                
   Hungary is located in the middle of the European continent and has a superior geographical location. Relatively cheap labour and the Hungarian government’s Eastern Opening strategy have attracted a       
   large number of Chinese                                                                                                                                                                                     
   companies to invest and build factories in recent years. For example, CATL                                                                                                                                  
   has invested more than 50 billion CNY to build a factory in Debrecen, Hungary, and BYD and other related industry chain companies have followed                                                             
   suit. These Chinese companies will provide a large number of jobs to the                                                                                                                                    
   local people, and being able to speak Chinese has become a major advantage for local people in finding jobs. Chinese language teaching in Hungary

   It can be said that Hungary has a solid foundation for learning Chinese.
