       "öm",                                                                                                                                                                                                   
       "ok",                                                                                                                                                                                                   
       "ek",                                                                                                                                                                                                   
       "ök",                                                                                                                                                                                                   
       "od",                                                                                                                                                                                                   
       "ed",                                                                                                                                                                                                   
       "öd",                                                                                                                                                                                                   
       "ott",                                                                                                                                                                                                  
       "ett",                                                                                                                                                                                                  
       "ött",                                                                                                                                                                                                  
       "ult",                                                                                                                                                                                                  
       "ült",                                                                                                                                                                                                  
   ]                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   ACTION_LEMMAS = {                                                                                                                                                                                           
       "ad",                                                                                                                                                                                                   
       "állít",                                                                                                                                                                                                
       "csinál",                                                                                                                                                                                               
       "ellenőriz",                                                                                                                                                                                            
       "ellenőrzi",                                                                                                                                                                                            
       "elindít",                                                                                                                                                                                              
       "elindítja",                                                                                                                                                                                            
       "fut",                                                                                                                                                                                                  
       "hordoz",                                                                                                                                                                                               
       "ír",                                                                                                                                                                                                   
       "jön",                                                                                                                                                                                                  
       "kap",                                                                                                                                                                                                  
       "kér",                                                                                                                                                                                                  
       "kérdez",                                                                                                                                                                                               
       "lát",                                                                                                                                                                                                  
       "lesz",                                                                                                                                                                                                 
       "lett",                                                                                                                                                                                                 
       "megy",                                                                                                                                                                                                 
       "megvan",                                                                                                                                                                                               
       "mond",                                                                                                                                                                                                 
       "módosít",                                                                                                                                                                                              
       "módosult",                                                                                                                                                                                             
       "olvas",                                                                                                                                                                                                
       "tesz",                                                                                                                                                                                                 
       "van",                                                                                                                                                                                                  
       "válaszol",                                                                                                                                                                                             
       "visz",                                                                                                                                                                                                 
   }                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   STATE_WORDS = {                                                                                                                                                                                             
       "állapot",                                                                                                                                                                                              
       "bizonyíték",                                                                                                                                                                                           
       "forrás",                                                                                                                                                                                               
       "hamis",                                                                                                                                                                                                
       "igaz",                                                                                                                                                                                                 
       "jó",                                                                                                                                                                                                   
       "kész",                                                                                                                                                                                                 
       "rossz",                                                                                                                                                                                                
       "szerver",                                                                                                                                                                                              
       "token",                                                                                                                                                                                                
   }                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   BUILTIN_SENTENCES = [                                                                                                                                                                                       
       "A macska az asztalon van.",                                                                                                                                                                            
       "Joco elindítja a szervert.",                                                                                                                                                                           
       "Horgony ellenőrzi a bizonyítékot.",                                                                                                                                                                    
       "A fájl módosult.",                                                                                                                                                                                     
       "Az állapot igaz, ha a forrás megvan.",                                                                                                                                                                 
       "A magyar mondat szigorú ragokkal hordoz viszonyokat.",                                                                                                                                                 
       "Csorló kérdez, Napló válaszol, Horgony ellenőriz.",                                                                                                                                                    
   ]                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   POS_DIM = 8                                                                                                                                                                                                 
   REAL_DIM = 16                                                                                                                                                                                               
   IMAG_DIM = 32                                                                                                                                                                                               
   QUAT_INTERNAL_DIM = 64                                                                                                                                                                                      
   QUAT_OVERLAP_DIM = 16                                                                                                                                                                                       
   TOTAL_DIM = POS_DIM + REAL_DIM + IMAG_DIM + (QUAT_INTERNAL_DIM - QUAT_OVERLAP_DIM)                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   @dataclass                                                                                                                                                                                                  
   class HungarianToken:                                                                                                                                                                                       
       index: int                                                                                                                                                                                              
       text: str                                                                                                                                                                                               
       norm: str                                                                                                                                                                                               
       role: str                                                                                                                                                                                               
       suffixes: list[str]                                                                                                                                                                                     
       vowel_harmony: str                                                                                                                                                                                      
       confidence: float                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   def stable_bucket(text: str, size: int) -> int:                                                                                                                                                             
       digest = hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).digest()                                                                                                                                                  
       return int.from_bytes(digest[:4], "big") % size                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   def stable_signed(text: str, salt: str = "") -> float:                                                                                                                                                      
       digest = hashlib.sha256((salt + text).encode("utf-8")).digest()                                                                                                                                         
       value = int.from_bytes(digest[:4], "big") / float(2**32 - 1)                                                                                                                                            
       return 2.0 * value - 1.0                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   def detect_vowel_harmony(norm: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                 
       vowels = {char for char in norm if char in ALL_VOWELS}                                                                                                                                                  
       if not vowels:                                                                                                                                                                                          
           return "none"                                                                                                                                                                                       
       has_front = bool(vowels & FRONT_VOWELS)                                                                                                                                                                 
       has_back = bool(vowels & BACK_VOWELS)                                                                                                                                                                   
       if has_front and has_back:                                                                                                                                                                              
           return "mixed"                                                                                                                                                                                      
       return "front" if has_front else "back"                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   def find_suffixes(norm: str, suffixes: list[str], max_count: int = 3) -> list[str]:                                                                                                                         
       found = []                                                                                                                                                                                              
       remainder = norm                                                                                                                                                                                        
       for suffix in sorted(suffixes, key=len, reverse=True):                                                                                                                                                  
           if len(remainder) <= len(suffix) + 1:                                                                                                                                                               
               continue                                                                                                                                                                                        
           if remainder.endswith(suffix):                                                                                                                                                                      
               found.append(suffix)                                                                                                                                                                            
               remainder = remainder[: -len(suffix)]                                                                                                                                                           
               if len(found) >= max_count:                                                                                                                                                                     
                   break                                                                                                                                                                                       
       return found                                                                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   def classify_token(index: int, text: str) -> HungarianToken:                                                                                                                                                
       norm = text.lower()                                                                                                                                                                                     
       if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", text):                                                                                                                                                                       
           return HungarianToken(index, text, norm, "integer", [], "none", 1.0)                                                                                                                                
       if not re.search(r"[A-Za-zÁÉÍÓÖŐÚÜŰáéíóöőúüű]", text):                                                                                                                                                  
           return HungarianToken(index, text, norm, "punctuation", [], "none", 1.0)                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
       case_suffixes = find_suffixes(norm, CASE_SUFFIXES)                                                                                                                                                      
       verb_suffixes = find_suffixes(norm, VERB_SUFFIXES)                                                                                                                                                      
       harmony = detect_vowel_harmony(norm)                                                                                                                                                                    
       suffixes = sorted(set(case_suffixes + verb_suffixes), key=len, reverse=True)                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
       is_state_word = norm in STATE_WORDS                                                                                                                                                                     
       is_action_word = norm in ACTION_LEMMAS                                                                                                                                                                  
       role = "noun_state"                                                                                                                                                                                     
       confidence = 0.45                                                                                                                                                                                       
       if norm in STATE_WORDS:                                                                                                                                                                                 
           role = "noun_state"                                                                                                                                                                                 
           confidence = 0.82                                                                                                                                                                                   
       if is_action_word or (verb_suffixes and not is_state_word):                                                                                                                                             
           role = "morphism_action"                                                                                                                                                                            
           confidence = max(confidence, 0.68)                                                                                                                                                                  
       if case_suffixes and role != "morphism_action" and not is_state_word:                                                                                                                                   
           role = "relation_case"                                                                                                                                                                              
           confidence = max(confidence, 0.62)                                                                                                                                                                  
       if norm.endswith(("ható", "hető", "atlan", "etlen", "ság", "ség")):                                                                                                                                     
           role = "state_modifier"                                                                                                                                                                             
           confidence = max(confidence, 0.58)                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
       return HungarianToken(index, text, norm, role, suffixes, harmony, confidence)                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   def tokenize_hungarian(sentence: str) -> list[HungarianToken]:                                                                                                                                              
       return [classify_token(index, match.group(0)) for index, match in enumerate(TOKEN_RE.finditer(sentence))]                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   def add_bucket(vector: list[float], offset: int, size: int, key: str, value: float = 1.0) -> None:                                                                                                          
       vector[offset + stable_bucket(key, size)] += value                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   def encode_token(token: HungarianToken, sequence_length: int) -> list[float]:                                                                                                                               
       vector = [0.0 for _ in range(TOTAL_DIM)]                                                                                                                                                                
       max_index = max(sequence_length - 1, 1)                                                                                                                                                                 
       is_word = token.role not in {"integer", "punctuation"}                                                                                                                                                  
       harmony_value = {"front": 1.0, "back": -1.0, "mixed": 0.25, "none": 0.0}[token.vowel_harmony]                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
       vector[0:POS_DIM] = [                                                                                                                                                                                   
           token.index / max_index,                                                                                                                                                                            
           math.sin(token.index),                                                                                                                                                                              
           math.cos(token.index),                                                                                                                                                                              
           min(len(token.text), 32) / 32.0,                                                                                                                                                                    
           1.0 if token.role == "integer" else 0.0,                                                                                                                                                            
           1.0 if token.role == "punctuation" else 0.0,                                                                                                                                                        
           1.0 if token.text[:1].isupper() and is_word else 0.0,                                                                                                                                               
           harmony_value,                                                                                                                                                                                      
       ]                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
       real_offset = POS_DIM                                                                                                                                                                                   
       add_bucket(vector, real_offset, REAL_DIM, "lex:" + token.norm, token.confidence)                                                                                                                        
       add_bucket(vector, real_offset, REAL_DIM, "role:" + token.role, 0.5)                                                                                                                                    
       for suffix in token.suffixes:                                                                                                                                                                           
           add_bucket(vector, real_offset, REAL_DIM, "suffix:" + suffix, 0.25)                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
       imag_offset = POS_DIM + REAL_DIM                                                                                                                                                                        
       if token.role in {"morphism_action", "relation_case"}:                                                                                                                                                  
           add_bucket(vector, imag_offset, IMAG_DIM, "arrow:" + token.role, 1.0)                                                                                                                               
       for suffix in token.suffixes:                                                                                                                                                                           
           add_bucket(vector, imag_offset, IMAG_DIM, "morphism-suffix:" + suffix, 0.7)                                                                                                                         
       add_bucket(vector, imag_offset, IMAG_DIM, "harmony:" + token.vowel_harmony, 0.3)                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
       quat_offset = POS_DIM + REAL_DIM + IMAG_DIM                                                                                                                                                             
       for group in range((QUAT_INTERNAL_DIM - QUAT_OVERLAP_DIM) // 4):                                                                                                                                        
           base = quat_offset + 4 * group                                                                                                                                                                      
           salt = f"q{group}:"                                                                                                                                                                                 
           vector[base] = token.confidence                                                                                                                                                                     
           vector[base + 1] = stable_signed(token.norm, salt + "i")                                                                                                                                            
           vector[base + 2] = stable_signed(token.role, salt + "j")                                                                                                                                            
           vector[base + 3] = stable_signed("|".join(token.suffixes), salt + "k") if token.suffixes else 0.0                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
       return vector                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   def encode_sentence(sentence: str) -> dict[str, Any]:                                                                                                                                                       
       tokens = tokenize_hungarian(sentence)                                                                                                                                                                   
       vectors = [encode_token(token, len(tokens)) for token in tokens]                                                                                                                                        
       labels = {                                                                                                                                                                                              
           "has_morphism": any(token.role == "morphism_action" for token in tokens),                                                                                                                           
           "has_relation_case": any(token.role == "relation_case" for token in tokens),                                                                                                                        
           "has_state_word": any(token.norm in STATE_WORDS or token.role == "state_modifier" for token in tokens),                                                                                             
       }                                                                                                                                                                                                       
       return {                                                                                                                                                                                                
           "sentence": sentence,                                                                                                                                                                               
           "tokens": [asdict(token) for token in tokens],                                                                                                                                                      
           "vectors": vectors,                                                                                                                                                                                 
           "labels": labels,                                                                                                                                                                                   
       }                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   def load_sentences(path: Path | None) -> list[str]:                                                                                                                                                         
       if path is None:                                                                                                                                                                                        
           return list(BUILTIN_SENTENCES)                                                                                                                                                                      
       rows = []                                                                                                                                                                                               
       for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():                                                                                                                                              
           stripped = line.strip()                                                                                                                                                                             
           if stripped:                                                                                                                                                                                        
               rows.append(stripped)                                                                                                                                                                           
       return rows or list(BUILTIN_SENTENCES)                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   def pad_vectors(encoded: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> tuple[list[list[list[float]]], list[list[float]], list[int]]:                                                                                             
       max_len = max(len(row["vectors"]) for row in encoded)                                                                                                                                                   
       batch = []                                                                                                                                                                                              
       labels = []                                                                                                                                                                                             
       lengths = []                                                                                                                                                                                            
       for row in encoded:                                                                                                                                                                                     
           vectors = list(row["vectors"])                                                                                                                                                                      
           lengths.append(len(vectors))                                                                                                                                                                        
           vectors.extend([[0.0] * TOTAL_DIM for _ in range(max_len - len(vectors))])                                                                                                                          
           batch.append(vectors)                                                                                                                                                                               
           labels.append(                                                                                                                                                                                      
               [                                                                                                                                                                                               
                   1.0 if row["labels"]["has_morphism"] else 0.0,                                                                                                                                              
                   1.0 if row["labels"]["has_relation_case"] else 0.0,                                                                                                                                         
                   1.0 if row["labels"]["has_state_word"] else 0.0,                                                                                                                                            
               ]                                                                                                                                                                                               
           )                                                                                                                                                                                                   
       return batch, labels, lengths                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   def train_torch_probe(encoded: list[dict[str, Any]], epochs: int) -> dict[str, Any]:                                                                                                                        
       try:                                                                                                                                                                                                    
           import torch                                                                                                                                                                                        
           from torch import nn                                                                                                                                                                                
       except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - runtime dependent                                                                                                                                        
           return {"torch_available": False, "torch_error": str(exc)}                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
       torch.manual_seed(42)                                                                                                                                                                                   
       batch, labels, lengths = pad_vectors(encoded)                                                                                                                                                           
       x = torch.tensor(batch, dtype=torch.float32)                                                                                                                                                            
       y = torch.tensor(labels, dtype=torch.float32)                                                                                                                                                           
       mask = torch.zeros((x.shape[0], x.shape[1], 1), dtype=torch.float32)                                                                                                                                    
       for row_index, length in enumerate(lengths):                                                                                                                                                            
           mask[row_index, :length, 0] = 1.0                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
       class SoftmaxFreeTypedNetwork(nn.Module):                                                                                                                                                               
           def __init__(self) -> None:                                                                                                                                                                         
               super().__init__()                                                                                                                                                                              
               hidden = 64                                                                                                                                                                                     
               self.pos = nn.Linear(POS_DIM, hidden)                                                                                                                                                           
               self.real = nn.Linear(REAL_DIM, hidden)                                                                                                                                                         
               self.imag = nn.Linear(IMAG_DIM, hidden)                                                                                                                                                         
               self.quat = nn.Linear(QUAT_INTERNAL_DIM - QUAT_OVERLAP_DIM, hidden)                                                                                                                             
               self.mix = nn.Sequential(nn.LayerNorm(hidden), nn.Tanh(), nn.Linear(hidden, hidden), nn.Tanh())                                                                                                 
               self.head = nn.Linear(hidden * 2, 3)                                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
           def forward(self, values: Any, token_mask: Any) -> Any:                                                                                                                                             
               pos = values[:, :, :POS_DIM]                                                                                                                                                                    
               real = values[:, :, POS_DIM : POS_DIM + REAL_DIM]                                                                                                                                               
               imag = values[:, :, POS_DIM + REAL_DIM : POS_DIM + REAL_DIM + IMAG_DIM]                                                                                                                         
               quat = values[:, :, POS_DIM + REAL_DIM + IMAG_DIM :]                                                                                                                                            
               state = self.pos(pos) + self.real(real) + self.imag(imag) + self.quat(quat)                                                                                                                     
               state = state + self.mix(state)                                                                                                                                                                 
               masked = state * token_mask                                                                                                                                                                     
               mean_pool = masked.sum(dim=1) / token_mask.sum(dim=1).clamp_min(1.0)                                                                                                                            
               max_pool = masked.masked_fill(token_mask == 0, -1e4).amax(dim=1)                                                                                                                                
               return self.head(torch.cat([mean_pool, max_pool], dim=-1))                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
       model = SoftmaxFreeTypedNetwork()                                                                                                                                                                       
       optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=0.02, weight_decay=0.001)                                                                                                                          
       loss_fn = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()                                                                                                                                                                        
       losses = []                                                                                                                                                                                             
       for _ in range(max(0, epochs)):                                                                                                                                                                         
           optimizer.zero_grad()                                                                                                                                                                               
           logits = model(x, mask)                                                                                                                                                                             
           loss = loss_fn(logits, y)                                                                                                                                                                           
           loss.backward()                                                                                                                                                                                     
           optimizer.step()                                                                                                                                                                                    
           losses.append(float(loss.detach().cpu()))                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
       with torch.no_grad():                                                                                                                                                                                   
           logits = model(x, mask)                                                                                                                                                                             
           predictions = (torch.sigmoid(logits) >= 0.5).to(torch.int64)                                                                                                                                        
           targets = y.to(torch.int64)                                                                                                                                                                         
           exact = (predictions == targets).all(dim=1).float().mean().item()                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
       return {                                                                                                                                                                                                
           "torch_available": True,                                                                                                                                                                            
           "network": "SoftmaxFreeTypedNetwork",                                                                                                                                                               
           "uses_attention_softmax": False,                                                                                                                                                                    
           "epochs": epochs,                                                                                                                                                                                   
           "initial_loss": losses[0] if losses else None,                                                                                                                                                      
           "final_loss": losses[-1] if losses else None,                                                                                                                                                       
           "label_exact_match": exact,                                                                                                                                                                         
           "parameter_count": sum(parameter.numel() for parameter in model.parameters()),                                                                                                                      
       }                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   def write_jsonl(path: Path, rows: Iterable[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:                                                                                                                                        
       path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)                                                                                                                                                          
       with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:                                                                                                                                                        
           for row in rows:                                                                                                                                                                                    
               handle.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True) + "\n")                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   def main() -> int:                                                                                                                                                                                          
       parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Run the Hungarian typed-state network prototype.")                                                                                                        
       parser.add_argument("--sentences", type=Path, help="Optional UTF-8 file with one Hungarian sentence per line.")                                                                                         
       parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=Path("data/hungarian-typed-network/smoke_report.json"))                                                                                              
       parser.add_argument("--encoded-output", type=Path, default=Path("data/hungarian-typed-network/encoded_tokens.jsonl"))                                                                                   
       parser.add_argument("--epochs", type=int, default=80)                                                                                                                                                   
       args = parser.parse_args()                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
       sentences = load_sentences(args.sentences)                                                                                                                                                              
       encoded = [encode_sentence(sentence) for sentence in sentences]                                                                                                                                         
       write_jsonl(                                                                                                                                                                                            
           args.encoded_output,                                                                                                                                                                                
           (                                                                                                                                                                                                   
               {                                                                                                                                                                                               
                   "sentence": row["sentence"],                                                                                                                                                                
                   "tokens": row["tokens"],                                                                                                                                                                    
                   "labels": row["labels"],                                                                                                                                                                    
                   "vector_dim": TOTAL_DIM,                                                                                                                                                                    
               }                                                                                                                                                                                               
               for row in encoded                                                                                                                                                                              
           ),                                                                                                                                                                                                  
       )                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
       report = {                                                                                                                                                                                              
           "prototype": "hungarian-typed-state-network-v0",                                                                                                                                                    
           "status": "smoke-test",                                                                                                                                                                             
           "vector_layout": {                                                                                                                                                                                  
               "position_integer_channels": POS_DIM,                                                                                                                                                           
               "real_noun_state_channels": REAL_DIM,                                                                                                                                                           
               "imaginary_morphism_channels": IMAG_DIM,                                                                                                                                                        
               "quaternion_truth_internal_channels": QUAT_INTERNAL_DIM,                                                                                                                                        
               "quaternion_overlap_with_state_channels": QUAT_OVERLAP_DIM,                                                                                                                                     
               "total_exported_channels": TOTAL_DIM,                                                                                                                                                           
           },                                                                                                                                                                                                  
           "sentence_count": len(sentences),                                                                                                                                                                   
           "token_count": sum(len(row["tokens"]) for row in encoded),                                                                                                                                          
           "tokenizer_boundary": "heuristic Hungarian suffix tokenizer; requires human grammar review",                                                                                                        
           "softmax_boundary": "prototype classifier uses sigmoid logits; no attention softmax is used",                                                                                                       
           "torch_probe": train_torch_probe(encoded, args.epochs),                                                                                                                                             
           "encoded_output": str(args.encoded_output),                                                                                                                                                         
       }                                                                                                                                                                                                       
       args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)                                                                                                                                                   
       args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")                                                                                       
       print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True))                                                                                                                                 
       return 0                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
   if __name__ == "__main__":                                                                                                                                                                                  
       raise SystemExit(main())
